text:
elaine (pm): Punted a short 'policy-onramp' note — need a quick thumbs on scope for Q3 pilots. https://redwood.share/policy-onramp

samir (arch): TL;DR: propose 3 modes — soft-affinity, hard-affinity, and hybrid. Each has clear infra and telemetry differences.

miguel (eng): Dev note: hard-affinity = reserved placement or node labels + eviction implications. Will cost more. Need product to pick pilots.

lina (cs): Customers want per-route residency and an explanation of failover behavior in contracts. We need a plain-language summary per policy.

nina (sre): Ops checklist (canary): 5% traffic, 20m stability, p95 <= 2x baseline, rollback if error-rate >0.4% or fallback events >2/min. Also synthetic probes per-region.

samir (arch): Example DSL for product/legal to read:
```
policy {
  id: "finco_payments"
  match: {customer: "FinCo", route: "payments"}
  isolation: "hard"
  regions: ["eu-west-1"]
  fallback: {allowed: false}
}
```

miguel (eng): Add defaults: min_reserved_gpus=1, max_burst=2x, eviction_window=5m. We'll refine after sizing.

elaine (pm): Launch gates (draft): 99.5% regional success over 24h canary, cost cap per-tenant, in-region KMS for residency, documented rollback + customer comms.

lina (cs): I'll prepare contract language and a customer comms template that clearly lists covered routes.

samir (arch): Telemetry requirement: every policy evaluation emits policy_id + outcome (hit/fallback) + chosen_region. Console needs a 'policy impact' view.

miguel (eng): I will run a sizing delta for 3 pilot candidates (FinCo, Acme, BetaLabs). ETA Tue.

elaine (pm): Actions: 1) Product add pilot rows by Mon EOD. 2) Eng sizing (miguel) Tue. 3) SRE runbook + probes (nina) Tue. 4) Arch telemetry spec (samir) Tue. Lock pilots Wed.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/policy-telemetry v0.3 -> staging (triggered by samir).

elaine (pm): thanks all — trying to keep onramp minimal so we can learn without large reserved spend.
